rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday term for the period immediately after a marriage.

example.english: We went on our honeymoon after getting married.
example.traditional: 我哋結婚之後去咗度蜜月。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 git3 fan1 zi1 hau6 heoi3 zo2 dou6 mat6 jyut6

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean the newlyweds’ honeymoon trip rather than the period itself.

example.english: Our honeymoon trip was to Okinawa.
example.traditional: 我哋嘅蜜月旅行去咗沖繩。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ge3 mat6 jyut6 leoi5 hang4 heoi3 zo2 cung1 sing2

rows.note: Use this for the temporary goodwill phase at the start of a new relationship, term, or arrangement.

example.english: Everyone is still in the honeymoon period during the new boss's first few months.
example.traditional: 新老闆上任頭幾個月，大家仲喺蜜月期。
example.jyutping: san1 lou5 baan2 soeng6 jam6 tau4 gei2 go3 jyut6 daai6 gaa1 zung6 hai2 mat6 jyut6 kei4
